title: Platform Consolidation Accelerating via Falcon Flex
statement: Enterprise customers are consolidating security spend onto the Falcon platform through the Flex subscription model producing measurable uplift in per-customer ARR and multi-module adoption rates.
caveat: OQ-001 (current Net Score); OQ-006 (churn normalization); OQ-007 (CCP lapsing impact)
evidenceStrength: Strong — multiple quantitative metrics from CrowdStrike IR filings across consecutive quarters (Q1 FY2026 through Q2 FY2027); corroborated by ETR Net Score composition data
sourceGaps: OQ-001 (current Net Score); OQ-006 (churn normalization); OQ-007 (CCP lapsing impact)

title: Post-Outage Spending Recovery in ETR TSIS Data
statement: CrowdStrike spending intent recovered from the post-outage trough and persisted through October 2026: Net Score 37.14 (+0.69 vs Jul 2026; +10.54 vs Oct 2025), Pervasion 40.90, with Q/Q Z 0.129 and Y/Y Z 0.892.
caveat: Z-Score method bands; cohort/region N; current retention; current shared accounts
evidenceStrength: Strong current-period base and breadth data; actual Z-Scores supplied; cohort and regional Ns remain missing.
sourceGaps: Z-Score method bands; cohort/region N; current retention; current shared accounts

title: Net New ARR Reacceleration Cycle
statement: CrowdStrike quarterly net new ARR troughed at $153M (Q3 FY2025) and reaccelerated in every subsequent quarter to a record $333M (Q2 FY2027 +51% YoY) with management raising FY2027 growth guidance by 630 basis points.
caveat: OQ-004 (ETR Forecaster validation); OQ-012 (TAM sustainability); OQ-013 (international growth)
evidenceStrength: Strong — consecutive quarterly earnings releases with audited financial data provide unbroken time series from Q3 FY2025 through Q2 FY2027.
sourceGaps: OQ-004 (ETR Forecaster validation); OQ-012 (TAM sustainability); OQ-013 (international growth)

title: AI Security (Mythos Moment) as New Demand Vector
statement: The emergence of AI agent threats and the Mythos moment created a new category of security demand (AIDR) with CrowdStrike positioning Falcon as the governance and trust layer for enterprise AI adoption.
caveat: OQ-009 (blast radius governance); OQ-012 (TAM validation); OQ-011 (ETR TSIS AI security signal)
evidenceStrength: Moderate — AIDR ARR nearly tripled QoQ and Qualitate captured 1249 customer conversations but AIDR absolute ARR undisclosed. Product launches announced but efficacy metrics unavailable.
sourceGaps: OQ-009 (blast radius governance); OQ-012 (TAM validation); OQ-011 (ETR TSIS AI security signal)

title: Enterprise Cohort Dominance (G2000 / Fortune 500)
statement: October 2026 select indexed enterprise cohorts were above overall Net Score: G2000 42.61 and F500 42.68 versus 37.14; Large Organizations were 35.82, so strength was selective.
evidenceStrength: Current data, but cohort N is not included in the supplied candlestick export.

title: Competitive Moat Resilience Despite Outage
statement: Despite July 2024 outage impacting 96% of surveyed customers CrowdStrike maintained 97% gross retention reduced replacement intent from 44% to 10% firm within 9 months recovered Pervasion and reaccelerated net new ARR to all-time records.
caveat: OQ-002 (current ETR outlook); OQ-006 (current churn); OQ-011 (2025 EPP Observatory)
evidenceStrength: Strong on retention metrics (audited); moderate on competitive positioning (ETR survey with gap). Resilience thesis rests on verified financial outcomes but competitive landscape impact is unresolved.
sourceGaps: OQ-002 (current ETR outlook); OQ-006 (current churn); OQ-011 (2025 EPP Observatory)
